intent: Repair the attached build 138 GitHub verdict, argument, recovery, gateway, output budget, diagnostic and speech failures; add bounded gateway/client debug exchange, selected-profile-only execution, faster GitHub loading and guided first-use setup. Redesign the GitHub Status tab with beginner-friendly bubble tiles modeled on the Windows gateway dashboard and live active-gateway stats/devices. Include the subsequent full 24-item diagnostic review: terminal job reconciliation, independent engineering readiness, durable execution/verification/delivery ledger, staged Research recovery, delegated child isolation, explicit tool readiness and compact diagnostic exports.

acceptance.review: Versioned deterministic PASS/FAIL/INDETERMINATE verdicts, bounded same-profile review and durable evidence/drafts.
acceptance.tools: Actionable schema-aware preflight, one safe correction and no unchanged invalid dispatch or uncertain write replay.
acceptance.gateway: Independent reachability/readiness/metadata signals; bounded connection recovery and sanitized exportable debug logs capped at 5000 lines, including client diagnostic exchange.
acceptance.identity: Every GitHub generation, tool planning, review and continuation uses the selected AI profile; failure cannot substitute another profile.
acceptance.onboarding: First-use welcome and guided authentication/profile/repository setup; returning GitHub mode renders without waiting for remote preparation; remove GitHub workshop entry from app Settings.
acceptance.voice: Unavailable recognition and binding failures preserve typed input without repeated service binding.
acceptance.validation: Behavior regressions, canonical host checks and Android compilation/tests for this revision. Live hardware/network behavior is qualified separately.
acceptance.status: A clean, minimal-text GitHub Status dashboard retains the tile/bubble system, exposes selected-profile gateway measurements and devices, distinguishes unavailable/stale data, and follows the Windows gateway layout.
acceptance.durable_recovery: Preserve original job identity, partial text, completed operations and unfinished verification across interruption; reconcile terminal results without replaying uncertain mutations; blocked reads remain recoverable after connectivity returns.
acceptance.research: Admit reasoning/output/context budgets before reservations; checkpoint bounded artifacts and stage attempts; retain successful children and permission-blocked partial evidence; no automatic selected-profile substitution.

validation.scope: Completed before publication; focused groups overlap and are not a full-app total.
validation.final_android_and_ci_evidence: Reported on the new pull request against its published head SHA; not inferred from focused tests.
validation.hardware: Not qualified by host tests; requires live phone, gateway/network and Windows installation acceptance.
validation.additional_diagnostic_scope: Focused recovery, Research, delegate, ledger, export and polling results are documented in the implementation ledger. Full Android and hosted CI results are recorded on PR #802 against its published head.

saved_gateway_verification_boundary_focu.generated_room_query: Covered by full Android suite after DAO regeneration; not inferred from focused coordinator mocks.

diagnostic_review.workmanager: Matching callback records were informational; no warning/error substantiated by this export.
